notes.title: Artbook and Soundtrack Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hello to those who enjoy Dead Lamb Walking. This is Lyn Mametchi, the creator.

Laserbat (the composer and my fiancé) and I have been deeply grateful for the lovely reviews, and quite surprised that there is a Japanese fanbase as well (thanks to the translator place_b who did it willingly for free).

The Art of Dead Lamb Walking artbook and official soundtrack are now fixed and available to purchase from the Steam page for those who would like to support me and Laserbat.

The game is free because I wanted everyone to be able to play it. I lived on savings for the months I worked on Dead Lamb Walking and greatly appreciate any support. 

Thank you!!
Lyn Mametchi
